row:
Vet Med Explained is a conversational veterinary learning channel created by a final-year vet student who needed revision that didn’t require sitting still with a textbook.

Each episode features two AI-generated hosts, who I like to call Hector and Clara, taking lively deep dives into vet med topics — from conditions and procedures to diagnostics, treatments, pathophysiology and clinical concepts.

Yes, the voices are AI. Yes, they can be a little dramatic sometimes. No, this isn’t copy-and-paste content. 

Episodes are built from carefully prepared veterinary learning notes and designed to make dense topics feel clearer, calmer and easier to revise.

Made for vet students, new grads, nurses and clinicians who want veterinary medicine explained in a way that actually sticks.

Subscribe for clear, conversational vet med deep dives.
